Alex: Morning async — quick status: onboarded tiny-quantized LlamaX-v2 to staging and ran the kb-extract-v3 promptset. Seeing a small factuality regression (F1 down ~3 pts) on longer contexts.
Maria: Got it. Can you paste a failing example or the eval trace?
Alex: Here's a representative case:
```
input: 'When was Redwood Inference founded?'
expected: '2019'
model: 'LlamaX-v2-tinyq'
output: '2018'
metrics: factuality_f1: 0.72 -> prev 0.75
```
Sam: I'll take a look at the promptset — could be tokenization boundary or prompt normalization. Which tokenizer/version did you use? Also pinging @Jen for kv cache warmup on staging.
Jen: On it — warming KV cache on dedicated staging pool now, ETA ~20m. If regressions persist after warmup it might be quant mismatch or attention fusion for longctx.
Eval Bot: CI: nightly-evals completed for branch alex/model-intake — 12 failing examples flagged (summary + detailed CSV): https://ci.internal/redwood/evals/4351236789/report
Maria: If it's consistent on the tinyq variant, let's schedule a small A/B run (tinyq vs fp16) for ~1000 samples to measure tradeoffs. I can spin that up.
Alex: Thanks. Small blocker: need a quick code review on PR #1234 — prompt normalization change (trim + lower + unicode normalize). @Sam, can you review? It's a tiny patch but affects many promptsets.
Sam: Will review today, aiming EOD. :thumbsup:
Jen: Heads-up: observed a perf spike on sequences >4k tokens in staging during warmup; filing ticket #789 for infra trace.
Alex: Cool — I'll attach the failing eval examples and add notes about tokenization. Today: prioritize prompt normalization CR, re-run evals after KV warmup, and coordinate A/B if Maria can spin it up.
Maria: Sounds good — ping me the branch and I’ll queue the A/B.
Sam: Review queued. If anything urgent, DM me.
Jen: KV warmup finished — ping me after you re-run so I can monitor latency. :white_check_mark:
